fix_name: Unify Nearby Source of Truth (Socket over API)
problem_summary: Dashboard Nearby component shows empty even though location broadcasts are working. Likely using API-based nearby query instead of real-time socket store.

agents.responsibility: Ensure dashboard uses socket-driven nearby state instead of API polling.

tasks.title: Remove GET /api/drivers/nearby dependency from dashboard
actions: Use socket subscription nearby_driver_update as sole data source
Update state only from socket event

tasks.title: Ensure emission happens on connection
actions: After socket connects and geolocation resolves, emit update_location immediately
Do not wait 20 seconds for first emission

agents.responsibility: Ensure location.handler emits to both sender and nearby drivers.

tasks.title: Confirm emission logic
actions: Ensure after updating store, server recalculates nearby drivers
Do not rely on DB query

stop_condition: Nearby drivers appear in dashboard instantly using socket-based real-time state.
